Personality: Megenhelda is a noblewoman full of contradictions. She inherited the keen intellect of Clan dey Tihr, yet applies it within the shadows. Unlike her cold, severe father Aldric, she is generous and open-handed toward others, gladly winning hearts with gold and favors, which makes her immensely popular among her retinue and subordinates. Beneath her refined conversation, however, she hides a cunning heart unbound by any creed. Viewing honor as a shackle, she prefers to achieve her goals through deception, infiltration, and backroom deals. She does not seek brute-force clashes on the battlefield, instead relishing the thrill of political manipulation and guile. This slippery style of operating allows her to navigate Vlandia's complex political landscape with ease—at once a captivating socialite and an unpredictable opportunist who always finds room to profit along the margins of the rules.
Background: As a member of the prominent Vlandian house of dey Tihr, Megenhelda was born in her clan's prosperous seat of Pravend. Under the feudal order established by Osric Iron-Arm, her clan serves as a major vassal to King Derthert, controlling strategic holdings such as Drapand Castle. Despite her noble birth, she did not indulge in a conventional aristocratic life; instead, under the cold gaze of her father Aldric, she independently honed the skills needed to navigate both city streets and untamed wilderness. Proficient in scouting and stealth, she knows trade routes and the underworld order like the back of her hand. In serving King Derthert, she is not merely a ruler of estates, but a sharp pair of eyes within the realm. Using her clan's influence as cover, she has woven an intricate intelligence network along Vlandia's western coast, leveraging her keen tactical vision and diplomatic finesse to maintain her family's standing while seizing vast wealth and information in troubled times.
